{"id":"project-LICHEN-worker6-9098.49","title":"metrics.py: export_csv collision rows drop tx_ids","description":"## Problem

record_collision appends a time-series row with details keys rx_node, tx_ids (list), channel. export_csv writes a fixed header:

  time_us, event_type, rx_node, tx_id, latency_us, channel

and fills tx_id via details.get("tx_id", ""). Collision events have tx_ids, not tx_id, so the identity of the overlapping transmissions is blank. Reception rows still have tx_id. 9098.36 fixed the 0 µs latency empty-cell; this column is still wrong for collisions.

test_csv_export_basic only asserts the substring "collision", not the tx_id cell. Capacity / A-B CSV oracles cannot tell which TXs collided.

## Files

- python/src/lichen/sim/metrics.py (record_collision time-series, export_csv)
- python/tests/sim/test_metrics.py (test_csv_export_basic)
